backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for a social media backend implementing posts, comments, likes, follows, friend requests, messaging, notifications, and user profiles with access control and blob storage mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping two ShortSport page features (auto-scroll toggle and removal of zoom/crop effect) to their implementing file and associated test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-sentence summaries of each frontend source file, describing component purposes and notable recent changes.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS entry file defining light and dark OKLCH CSS custom properties for the design token system (colors, borders, sidebar, charts).
frontend/index.html: Minimal HTML shell with the app title set to 'Smileup' and a root div that mounts the React app via main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that wraps the app in ThemeProvider, InternetIdentityProvider, and QueryClientProvider, showing a loading splash, LandingPage for unauthenticated users, or the full router for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/AvatarPlaceholde: Reusable avatar component that renders a profile picture from an ExternalBlob URL or falls back to gradient initials, supporting xs–xl sizes and both legacy and new prop naming conventions.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with six icon links (Home, Explore, ShortSport, Messages, Create, Profile) that hides on the ShortSport route and shows a dot indicator when conversations exist.
frontend/src/components/CommentsSheet.ts: A bottom sheet component for displaying and submitting comments on a post, supporting both open/onOpenChange and isOpen/onClose prop conventions.
frontend/src/components/editor/AudioPane: An editor panel for managing audio tracks, supporting file upload and mock recording, with per-track volume sliders, mute toggles, and removal controls.
frontend/src/components/editor/DesignPan: A React panel component for editing canvas design properties including aspect ratio, background color/gradient presets, shape overlays, and decorative elements. Exposes controls that update the shared EditorState via an onUpdate callback.
frontend/src/components/editor/EditorCan: A canvas-based preview component that renders the current editor state including background color, text layers, sticker layers, filter effects (brightness/contrast/etc.), vignette, glitch, and letterbox overlays using the HTML5 Canvas API.
frontend/src/components/editor/EditorTim: A timeline UI component that displays video/image/blank clips on a scrollable ruler, supports scrubbing the playhead, removing clips, and adding new blank clips, with zoom-aware pixel-per-second scaling.
frontend/src/components/editor/EffectsPa: A panel for toggling motion graphic effects (confetti, glitch, letterbox, film grain, etc.) on the editor state, displaying active effects as tags and showing a placeholder when none are selected.
frontend/src/components/editor/ExportPan: An export and share panel that previews the selected video clip, allows editing title/description metadata, and provides a download button that triggers a browser file download of the video.
frontend/src/components/editor/FiltersPa: A filters panel offering preset filter styles (Moody, Cinematic, Noir, etc.) and individual slider controls for brightness, contrast, saturation, hue, vignette, and other adjustments, with a reset-to-defaults option.
frontend/src/components/editor/StickersP: A React panel component for adding and managing emoji sticker layers on a video editor, supporting categorized emoji selection, sticker placement with random positioning, and controls for size, rotation, and timing.
frontend/src/components/editor/TextPanel: A React panel component for adding and managing text layers in a video editor, with controls for font, size, color, bold/italic, alignment, animation, and timing per layer.
frontend/src/components/editor/Transitio: A React panel component that displays a library of video transitions and allows users to apply specific transitions between consecutive clips in the editor state.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Root layout component that wraps all pages with a TopBar, main content outlet, and BottomNav.
frontend/src/components/NotificationsPan: Dropdown panel that lists user notifications (follows, messages) with avatars, relative timestamps, and click-to-navigate behavior, marking items as read on interaction.
frontend/src/components/PostCard.tsx: Card component for rendering a single post with media, author info, like/comment/share/bookmark actions, optimistic like updates, and intersection-observer-based view recording.
Modal dialog that displays the current user's posts as a thumbnail grid, allowing selection of a post to share in a message.
frontend/src/components/ShareModal.tsx: Modal for sharing a post with one or more friends via direct message, with multi-select friend list and send confirmation.
frontend/src/components/StoriesRow.tsx: Horizontally scrollable stories row showing the current user's story button with a popup menu and mock friend stories that open a viewer modal on tap.
frontend/src/components/StoryViewerModal: A full-screen modal component for viewing a single story, displaying the user's avatar, name, handle, timestamp, and a progress bar, with Escape key and backdrop-click dismissal.
frontend/src/components/TopBar.tsx: A sticky top navigation bar showing the Smileup wordmark, notification bell with unread badge, search button, and sign-out button, with a dropdown notifications panel.
frontend/src/components/TrendingProfiles: A horizontally scrollable section displaying top creator cards fetched via useGetTopCreators, with loading skeletons, an empty state, and navigation to individual profile pages.
frontend/src/components/VideoCard.tsx: A card component for displaying a video post with thumbnail, play button, duration badge, like/comment/share/bookmark actions, and a double-tap like animation.
frontend/src/components/YourStoryPopup.t: A small dropdown popup anchored below a story bubble offering two actions: viewing the user's own posts or creating a new post, with outside-click dismissal.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A custom React hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, supporting both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) usage, and invalidates dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook for React, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flows, identity persistence, and delegation validity checks.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines a collection of React Query hooks for fetching and mutating backend data including posts, comments, user profiles, and social features like likes, views, and friend requests.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that sets up Tailwind CSS, imports Inter and Syne fonts, defines CSS custom properties for light/dark themes using OKLCH color values, and adds utility classes for glassmorphism, gold gradients, and scrollbar hiding.
frontend/src/lib/mockData.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces (Post, Comment, User, Story, Message, Conversation) and exports static mock data arrays for users, stories, and related entities used for UI development and testing.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports utility functions: `cn` for merging Tailwind class names, `formatNumber` for compact number display (K/M), `formatTime` for mm:ss formatting, and `timeAgo` for relative timestamps.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that renders the React app with QueryClientProvider (React Query), InternetIdentityProvider, and the root App component into the DOM.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePostPage.tsx: Page component for creating a new post, supporting file upload or URL input for photo/video/GIF/poster media types, with caption input and submission via the `useCreatePost` mutation hook.
frontend/src/pages/EditorPage.tsx: Full-featured video/design editor page that manages editor state (clips, text layers, stickers, audio, filters, effects) and renders a panel-based UI with tools for trimming, filters, effects, stickers, design, and export.
frontend/src/pages/ExplorePage.tsx: Explore page with a debounced search input and tabs for browsing/searching posts or users, fetching data via `useGetAllPosts` and `useSearchUsers` hooks and rendering results with navigation to user profiles.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Displays the main social feed with stories, trending profiles, and a sorted list of posts. Handles loading skeletons, error states, empty states, and opens a comments sheet on post interaction.
frontend/src/pages/LandingPage.tsx: Unauthenticated landing page for Smileup that shows a branded login button using Internet Identity. Includes a tagline, feature highlights, and a footer with attribution.
frontend/src/pages/MessagesPage.tsx: Full messaging UI with conversation list, message thread view, friend requests tab, and the ability to send text messages or share posts. Includes unread counts, time formatting, and post-picker modal.
frontend/src/pages/MessageThreadPage.tsx: Thin wrapper page that extracts a principalId route param and renders MessagesPage with that principal pre-selected as the initial conversation.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: User profile page showing avatar, bio, follower/following counts, and a grid of the user's posts. Supports inline profile editing, avatar upload, logout, and opening a comments sheet on post tap.
frontend/src/pages/ShortSportPage.tsx: TikTok-style vertical video feed (ShortSpots) with auto-scroll, mute toggle, like, comment, share, and view recording. Each video item manages its own play/pause state based on whether it is the active slide.
frontend/src/pages/UserProfilePage.tsx: React page component that displays a user's profile by principal or handle, showing posts, follow/unfollow controls, and a friend action button with states for pending/accepted/incoming friend requests.
frontend/src/routeTree.ts: Defines the TanStack Router route tree for the app, mapping paths like '/', '/explore', '/user/$principal', '/profile/$handle', and '/messages/$principalId' to their respective page components.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility module providing functions to read URL query parameters (including hash-based routing), persist them to sessionStorage, and remove sensitive params from the URL hash without reloading.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH-based color tokens, surface/sidebar/chart colors, custom fonts (Inter, Syne), border radii, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state metadata for the Smileup sports social app, tracking existing features and pending fix requests related to ShortSport auto-scroll toggle placement and video zoom/crop issues.
